attempts.raw: BYOK stands for Bring Your Own Key, which is a security feature in model-powered applications that allows users to manage their own cryptographic keys. This feature enables users to have full control over their keys and can be used to encrypt sensitive data stored in the application. ByOK is a common security feature in many model-powered applications and is used to ensure that user data is secure and protected from unauthorized access.
